book.title: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus

content: Yesu Dlǝm undi Batti Libi ki Lya u nǝ tǝ pǝldli u
Yesu ɗǝpeti tet libi ki Lya, nǝm age'mil kushtiwasi i ultisu, “Mullashti, nǝyen undi zǝnga i nǝ kǝpbi i!”
I Yesu ultisu, “Kǝn ɗǝye' unndibas kǝpbi iwa?” Ba zǝnga u nǝ bǝkǝn dizhatti takawai u.
Yesu kǝdǝmi atǝn zǝga Zaitun gunǝ ɗǝ ya' libi ki Lya u iki Bitlus, nǝ Yakubu, nǝ Yahaya, nǝ Andalawas is gyemti amalgǝni
“Dlǝmimi anǝmi sǝppǝl usi u? Undi ulu kǝntǝn yeni gasi u nǝɗǝ lyap ndatu?”
I Yesu ulsisu, “Maninca bǝ mulǝn gǝl kiniwai.
Mbalǝn diɓǝli sǝn bǝti ge' shin ini, asi ussu ‘Siki ami,’ hal Sǝngǝl mbalǝn diɓǝli.
Inki kup shilǝn ki dlati dlati nǝ kumini kumini wasǝn u bǝ ɓatlwakǝn tlǝwai. Hwel nǝgu tǝnda, amma pati bisi i' ɓalla u wai.
Mɓalǝn nǝntli yelsǝni mbalǝn, gunti, nǝntli gunti. Nǝngotti kup nyapti ki atli agǝ luyen, nǝ kuzǝn. Ngo nǝnǝgu la'ti gǝs ki bǝnani.”
“Pǝn ɗemɗem nǝ gawakǝn, gakisǝn tilakin kina ɗǝ mik atli, as likin age lu dopga ki Yahudawa. Gaki shin ini, kin dliti akina ɗǝmik kǝndǝdlom nǝ gumsi tǝn gaki ki pisi ulnǝ' manini u.
Adǝmi hwel gopti shilǝn ki Lya kǝn pa tǝn dlǝmi mbalǝn.
Ga'si unǝ satǝlakin kina ɗǝ gumsi' u, bǝ hwok kiniwai, ngo nǝnǝgu kini kǝmil shilǝnwai, Yalkimbatl ki Lya kǝn bǝtl kin ulki dlǝmi.
Yel'se nǝn bǝtl yel'sewasi as tloti, bwasi tǝn bǝtl yakuwasi mil nǝn tlǝlli' mikzi'si as laki a tlosi.
Mbalǝn nǝnnge'kini gaki shin ini, ngo nǝnǝgu mulnǝ a ngashbi nǝpatwasu tǝnpeti.”
Besǝn Bǝna
Ka yenǝn a dllǝl bezǝn kyautǝn mull cik zhenti gelu unǝ bǝ a mbunwai u (mull dlǝm lashti tǝmmanica), Ginǝ ge' atl ki Yahudiya u as kitǝli as tege'zǝnga.
Mulnǝ ge libi ki lya u bǝppe' suɗi atte' libi gaki ka' ullǝnwai.
Mulnǝ agegu u bǝ pal te' ɗǝ ka' lulutwai.
Mi' tugi nǝ mi' mil kali age'cin u ulki cik go'kǝni!
Shilǝnni nǝ Lya bǝ ulu nda age' watlǝnwai.
Age cin u nǝnpǝl bezǝn lǝɓa u nǝ bǝ a pǝldlǝ gason wai u, tun nǝ Lya pǝl dǝplǝɓa, i mbǝl cin ki sǝti, kǝnpǝl u ndwas nǝwai, nǝpatiki dǝplǝɓa.
“Tǝ' Lya abosǝn mutti takawai u, da mulǝn kǝnsatwai, gaki ginǝ olsi i, in ndokǝl mutti taka.
Age cin u inmullǝn a ulkisu, ‘Yen Almasihu ngu u!’ Ko ‘yenǝn, ti ngwa!’ Bǝ ndǝniwai.
Gaki almasihu ki lǝgati nǝ mik njeshinkǝn ki Lya ki lǝgatti sǝn peti teɗi asi pǝl ulkǝ gagashinti tǝn gaki sǝ'gǝl ginǝ' olsi i, ǝnnǝn pǝtu.
Tǝngaki nǝgu a' pǝn ɗemɗem; apikini mus lǝɓa u nǝ nǝn ndatu.”
Patl ki Yakǝn Mbalǝn
“Amma age' muttyi, kalki bǝna,

content.text: Nǝn wu' bas lǝɓa ki lya.’

content: “Age' cin u mbalǝn nǝn ye' Yakǝn mbalǝn ɗǝ mbǝtige' ku'kuti, nǝ naltwasi nǝ ndǝlti.
Tǝnshik mil shinkǝnwas suɗi as dom ginǝ' olsi kal nǝ kina, tohna nǝ tohshimti, nǝ ngwatlti ki dǝplǝɓa nǝ ki lya.”
Cimbǝlti tǝn Pǝt ki Kah
“Kulcin ulǝn tǝn pǝt ki kah: Kayenǝn tǝɓal dǝltu, manini watlǝn ɓal nja i.
Ɗaɗanu kayenǝn u ndigi ɗǝ ndatu, manini tǝɓal nja i, tǝn bidlabi kǝn tiɓali.
Balini, amipikkini, hwonnu kǝnpatwai, sainǝ mus usi a nda.
Lya nǝ atli nǝn pati amma shilǝn yini kǝnpa'twai.”
“Amma cini nǝ gasi isi, mullǝn maniwai ko mik shinkǝni ko Yakǝni, mul zǝtti mani katl.
Pǝn ɗemɗem! Dǝmni nǝ manti aki shilǝn nǝ Lya! Gaki ki manǝn gasi u nǝtǝ cin u mbǝ uwai.
Kǝnǝ mullǝ'lo kǝni: Isza' libiwasi ipbǝl zheliwasi kyautǝn ko gukǝni nǝ kyautǝnwasi, i'ul mul kitǝn dlabi usu Dlǝlgal.
Dlǝlnigal, gaki kǝmanǝn gasi unǝ tǝmullibini paluwai, ko asuti ko agasi ko abilucili ko nǝ kyau.
Bǝm mbǝ katl, ambikin ɗǝ nde' Yemmbuɗwai.
Ulna dlǝmmikini u, I ami pikkini: ‘dlǝlni galt!’ ”
